best_idea: A position report is only a claim, so the server checks it against max speed x a tolerance x elapsed time, counts hits in a sliding window, rolls back to the last accepted point, and kicks only after repeated rollbacks.
decision_why: Duels are decided by server input intake, so this check should not run on duel positions; it fits free-roam zone positions if a client reports them, and the rollback must stay a position change that never touches fight state.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a report above 1.15x the allowed distance is not applied; the 6th hit inside 1.5 s rolls back to the last accepted position; hits 6 to 10 roll back and hit 11 disconnects; a report within the allowance is never flagged; a 750 ms grace follows a max-speed drop.
